findings: Figure 25.3 has arrows labelled NH3 from the alcohol to the amine and to the amide, and V2O5 from the aldehyde to the acid; these are not standard and are not copied (the aldehyde is oxidised with acidified dichromate). It labels alkene hydration H2O, H2SO4; the redrawn map uses steam with H3PO4 as in Chapter 22.
Figure 25.4 makes phenol from benzenesulphonic acid with '(i) NaOH (ii) HCl'; industrially this needs fusion with NaOH at high temperature. 'benene sulfonic acid' is spelled correctly.
